@@ -483,8 +538,49 @@
     final toolMedia = _toolMedia(toolName, content, isError);
-    final isLight = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.light;
+    return Container(
+      margin: _tileMargin,
+      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
+      decoration: BoxDecoration(
+        color: isLight ? const Color(0xFFF9FAFB) : palette.panelAlt,
+        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
+        border: _toolTileBorder(context, palette, isError, isLight),
+      ),
+      child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: start, children: [
+          if (toolName != null) ..._toolTileHeader(context, palette, toolName, content, isError, isLight),
+          _toolTileBody(context, palette, toolName, content, isError),
+          ..._toolTileMedia(context, generatedImagePath: generatedImagePath, toolMedia: toolMedia),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+
+  /// The two special tool surfaces checked BEFORE the generic tile:
+  /// permission-denied cards (orange badge + working action buttons) and
+  /// auth-expired cards (an Authorize button that re-launches the SSO flow).
+  Widget? _specialToolCard(BuildContext context, FahColors palette, String? toolName, String content, bool isLight) {
+    // permission-denied check (content-based, not just isError)
+    ... onPermissionAction card ...
+    // auth-expired check: authExpiredProvider(content)
+    ... onAuthRecovery card ...
+    return null;
+  }

NOTE ordering change: ORIGINAL computed toolMedia BEFORE the isLight line and BEFORE the special-card checks; special cards were returned BEFORE the Container, same as new. New code hoisted `isLight` + `_specialToolCard` check to the TOP of _toolOrSystemTile — verify hoisting `isLight` earlier changes nothing (pure read of Theme).

+  Border? _toolTileBorder(...) => isLight ? _lightToolTileBorder(palette, isError) : _darkToolTileBorder(context, palette, isError);
+  Border? _lightToolTileBorder(FahColors palette, bool isError) => isError ? Border.all(color: palette.error.withValues(alpha: 0.3)) : null;
+  Border _darkToolTileBorder(BuildContext context, FahColors palette, bool isError) => Border.all(color: isError ? palette.error.withValues(alpha: 0.45) : Theme.of(context).dividerColor);

+  List<Widget> _toolTileHeader(...) {
+    return [
+      Row(children: [
+        Icon(isError ? close : check, size: 14, color: isError ? palette.error : (isLight ? palette.indigo : palette.teal)),
+        SizedBox(width: 6),
+        Expanded(child: Text(_toolDisplayName(toolName), overflow: ellipsis, style: bodySmall w600 13, color: isError ? palette.error : palette.indigo)),
+        Icon(keyboard_arrow_down, 16, palette.dim a0.5),
+        SizedBox(width: 8),
+        _CopyIconButton(text: content, color: palette.dim a0.7),
+      ]),
+      if (content.isNotEmpty) const SizedBox(height: 6),
+    ];
+  }
